newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Smurfit says bottom of cycle reached.
newsitem.headline: Smurfit says bottom of cycle reached.

text.p: Ireland's Jefferson Smurfit Group Plc said on Wednesday that bottom had been reached in the paper and packaging industry cycle.

"We are beginning to see a re-rating of the industry in recent weeks, predicated on a forward momentum in pricing," Chairman and Chief Executive Michael Smurfit told shareholders at the group's annual meeting.
"We look forward to the future with confidence," he said.
Smurfit said that there had already been a price increase in newsprint and there was a good chance of another one around the turn of the year.
He also anticipated price inreases in liner board, the company's main product, but said it was more likely to be August than July.
